definition: a formal phrase used to begin an email or letter and state its purpose
vi: Tôi viết thư này để... (câu mở đầu thư trang trọng)
example: I am writing to express my concern about the poor service I received at your Richmond branch.
collocations: I am writing to complain about
I am writing to inquire about
synonyms: the purpose of this email is to

definition: to make an official statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory
example: If the problem isn't fixed by Friday, I will file a complaint with the head office.
collocations: file a complaint with the manager

definition: money given back to a customer, for example when they return a product
example: The store gave me a full refund because the jacket was damaged.

definition: a document, usually a receipt, showing that you bought something
vi: bằng chứng mua hàng (hóa đơn, biên lai)
example: Returns are accepted within 30 days with proof of purchase.

definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product if it breaks within a certain time
example: The repair was free because the laptop was still under warranty.

definition: not working correctly because of a fault
vi: bị lỗi, hỏng (do nhà sản xuất)
example: I'd like to return this kettle because it's defective; it won't turn on.

definition: to find a solution to a problem
example: The agent was able to resolve the issue with my bill in less than ten minutes.

definition: to pass a problem or complaint to a person with more authority
vi: chuyển (vụ việc, khiếu nại) lên cấp cao hơn
example: When the agent couldn't help, I asked her to escalate my case to a supervisor.

definition: something, usually money, given to someone for a loss or problem
vi: sự bồi thường, tiền đền bù
example: The airline offered a $200 travel voucher as compensation for the cancelled flight.

definition: a polite phrase used to say sorry for causing someone trouble
vi: xin lỗi vì sự bất tiện
example: We apologize for the inconvenience and will deliver your order tomorrow at no extra cost.
collocations: we apologize for any inconvenience caused

definition: a formal way to say 'as soon as you can'
vi: sớm nhất khi có thể (cách nói lịch sự)
example: Please contact me at your earliest convenience to arrange a replacement.
collocations: call me at your earliest convenience

term: look forward to hearing from you
definition: a formal closing phrase meaning you hope the reader will reply soon
vi: mong sớm nhận được phản hồi của anh/chị
example: Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to hearing from you.
collocations: I look forward to hearing from you soon
synonyms: hope to hear from you soon

definition: a polite way to make a request in formal writing or speech
vi: Tôi rất cảm kích nếu... (cách đề nghị lịch sự)
example: I would appreciate it if you could send a technician before the weekend.
collocations: I would appreciate it if you could
I would really appreciate it if

definition: a polite formal phrase inviting someone to contact you or ask freely
example: If you need any further information, please do not hesitate to call me.
collocations: please do not hesitate to contact me
please do not hesitate to ask

definition: too bad to be allowed or tolerated
example: Waiting three weeks for a simple repair is completely unacceptable.

definition: not pleased with something
example: I am dissatisfied with the way my complaint was handled by your staff.

definition: broken or harmed while being shipped
vi: bị hư hỏng trong quá trình vận chuyển
example: Two of the chairs were damaged in transit, so we refused the delivery.

definition: how happy customers are with a product or service
vi: sự hài lòng của khách hàng
example: The company sends a short survey after each call to measure customer satisfaction.

definition: to make a caller wait on the phone line
vi: bắt chờ máy (khi gọi điện thoại)
example: I was put on hold for forty minutes before anyone answered.
collocations: be on hold for an hour

definition: a person who speaks or acts for a company, especially to customers
vi: nhân viên đại diện (chăm sóc khách hàng)
example: A customer service representative will call you back within 24 hours.

definition: a number given to an order, case or complaint so it can be found later
vi: mã số tham chiếu (đơn hàng, hồ sơ)
example: Please include your reference number in all future emails about this order.

definition: an amount of money you can spend only at that store, instead of a cash refund
vi: tín dụng mua hàng tại cửa hàng (thay vì hoàn tiền mặt)
example: Without a receipt, they could only offer me store credit.

definition: as a kind action to show good intentions, often to keep a customer happy
vi: như một cử chỉ thiện chí
example: As a goodwill gesture, the hotel took one night off our bill.
collocations: offer a discount as a goodwill gesture
refund the fee as a goodwill gesture

definition: polite and respectful
example: The driver was courteous and carried the boxes right into our garage.

definition: done quickly and without delay
example: Thank you for your prompt reply; the issue has now been fixed.

definition: to officially not require a fee or rule in a particular case
example: The manager agreed to waive the late fee because it was my first time.

definition: to correct something that is wrong
example: We will rectify the billing error and credit your account by Monday.

definition: to investigate or examine a problem
example: Our team will look into why your package was sent to the wrong address.

definition: to ask someone to pay more than the correct price
vi: tính tiền quá mức, tính dư tiền
example: I think the cashier overcharged me; the sale price wasn't applied.

definition: to accept that you caused something and must deal with it
example: The courier company refused to take responsibility for the lost parcel.

definition: the place in a store where staff help with returns, questions and problems
example: Please bring the item and your receipt to the customer service desk at the front of the store.
collocations: go to the customer service desk
ask at the customer service desk

definition: an office where staff answer phone calls from customers
vi: tổng đài, trung tâm chăm sóc khách hàng qua điện thoại
example: I phoned the call centre three times before someone finally fixed my internet bill.

definition: a service on a website where you can type messages to a staff member in real time
vi: trò chuyện trực tuyến (với nhân viên hỗ trợ)
example: The live chat agent sorted out my delivery problem in five minutes.

definition: to ask to talk to a person in charge, usually to complain
example: When the clerk refused to help, I asked to speak to a manager.
collocations: ask to speak to a manager
demand to speak to a manager
I'd like to speak to a manager

definition: to deliver a product that is different from the one the customer ordered
example: It's frustrating when stores send the wrong item; I ordered a grey sofa but received a blue one.

definition: comments and opinions from customers about a product or service
vi: phản hồi/ý kiến của khách hàng
example: The store changed its opening hours based on customer feedback.

definition: to receive a new item in place of one that is broken or wrong
example: Since the kettle stopped working after a week, I'd like to get a replacement.

definition: to no longer function properly
example: My new headphones stopped working after only two weeks.
collocations: stop working after a few days

definition: pieces that should be in a package but are not
vi: thiếu linh kiện, thiếu bộ phận
example: The bookshelf arrived with missing parts, so I couldn't put it together.

definition: the rules and details of an agreement that a customer accepts
example: Read the terms and conditions before you sign up for the free trial.
collocations: agree to the terms and conditions

definition: the small, detailed text in a contract that may contain important conditions
vi: điều khoản in chữ nhỏ (dễ bị bỏ qua)
example: The fine print said the warranty doesn't cover water damage.

definition: to stop a regular service that you pay for
vi: huỷ đăng ký (dịch vụ định kỳ)
example: I tried to cancel a subscription online, but the website kept asking me to call instead.

definition: a mistake on a bill or invoice
example: There was a billing error on my phone bill, and I was charged for two lines.

definition: to have the same payment taken from your account two times by mistake
example: I was charged twice for the same order and would like one payment refunded.
collocations: be charged twice for the same item

definition: good enough; acceptable
example: If I do not receive a satisfactory response within a week, I will take further action.

definition: not giving any help or useful information
vi: không giúp ích, thiếu nhiệt tình
example: The staff member was unhelpful and simply told me to check the website.

definition: a recorded or computer-generated message, not one from a real person
example: All I got was an automated message saying my call was important to them.

definition: to mail or take something to a company so it can be fixed
example: I had to send my laptop in for repair, and it took almost a month to come back.
collocations: send a device in for repair
send it in for repair under warranty

definition: a worker trained to install or repair equipment
example: The internet company is sending a technician between 8 a.m. and noon.

definition: not damaged; still working and looking fine
vi: còn tốt, trong tình trạng tốt
example: Returned items must be in good condition with all tags attached.

definition: the box and materials a product came in when it was sold
example: Please return the blender in its original packaging if possible.

definition: a printed label used to send an item back to the seller
example: The online store emailed me a prepaid return label to print at home.

definition: a promise to return your money if you are not happy with a product
example: The mattress comes with a money-back guarantee if you are not completely satisfied.

definition: to end a phone call, sometimes suddenly
example: After 40 minutes on hold, I was about to hang up when an agent finally answered.

definition: a customer who has bought from the same business for a long time
example: As a loyal customer for over ten years, I was disappointed by how my complaint was handled.

definition: to send a phone call to another person or department
example: The agent said she would transfer my call to the billing department.
collocations: transfer a call to another department
transfer a call to a supervisor

definition: how long it takes for a company to answer or react to a request
example: The company promises a response time of 24 hours for all emails.

definition: making you feel annoyed because you cannot do or change something
example: It was very frustrating to explain the same problem to four different agents.

definition: a formal way to say that something you expected has not arrived
vi: tôi vẫn chưa nhận được (cách nói trang trọng)
example: Although I paid three weeks ago, I have yet to receive my order.
collocations: I have yet to receive a reply
I have yet to receive my refund
I have yet to receive any update

definition: quickly, within a reasonable amount of time
example: I would appreciate it if you could resolve this matter in a timely manner.

definition: paying close attention to what customers need
example: The server was attentive without being pushy, so we left a generous tip.

definition: to fail to work correctly; a failure to work correctly
example: The dishwasher began to malfunction just after the warranty expired.

definition: a return phone call from a company, often requested so you do not have to wait on hold
vi: cuộc gọi lại (từ phía công ty)
example: Instead of waiting on hold, I requested a callback, and an agent phoned me an hour later.

definition: to manage to reach someone by phone
vi: gọi được cho ai, liên lạc được (qua điện thoại)
example: I tried all morning but couldn't get through to anyone at the head office.

definition: to deal with a worry or problem that someone has raised
example: Thank you for taking the time to address my concerns so quickly.

definition: a formal phrase used to give bad news politely
vi: chúng tôi rất tiếc phải thông báo (cách báo tin xấu trang trọng)
example: I regret to inform you that the item you ordered has been discontinued.
collocations: I regret to inform you that
regret to inform you of a delay
synonyms: I am sorry to tell you

definition: to be less good than people hoped or expected
example: Unfortunately, the service at your new location continues to fall short of my expectations.

definition: the final problem in a series that makes you lose patience
example: The late delivery was annoying, but the rude driver was the last straw.

definition: to do something good to correct a bad situation or a mistake
vi: bù đắp cho, đền bù cho
example: To make up for the long delay, the restaurant gave us free dessert.

definition: a problem that has continued for some time and is not yet solved
vi: vấn đề kéo dài, chưa được giải quyết
example: This is an ongoing issue that I have reported three times since January.

definition: to find and fix problems, especially with equipment or software
vi: tìm và khắc phục sự cố
example: The agent helped me troubleshoot the modem over the phone.

definition: to write down a request, promise or complaint so there is a record
example: If the manager promises a refund, ask him to put it in writing.

definition: to make someone accept responsibility for what they did
example: Customers should hold companies accountable when they fail to keep their promises.

definition: showing that you do not think something is important or worth considering
vi: xem nhẹ, gạt đi, tỏ thái độ coi thường
example: The supervisor was dismissive of my complaint and didn't even look at the receipt.

definition: to make a process happen more quickly
example: Could you please expedite the replacement, as I need the part for work next week?

definition: without success, despite trying
vi: vô ích, không có kết quả
example: I have contacted your office several times, but to no avail.

definition: a formal complaint about something you think is unfair
vi: khiếu nại chính thức, nỗi bất bình
example: The company has a clear process for customers who wish to submit a grievance.
